label: OrganicCertification
description: An organic certification held by a farm operation — certifier, certificate number, and current status (USDA Organic INTEGRITY Database as served by farm.rootz.global). Epistery-published vocabulary; a certification is a standing claim about an operation, not a thing schema.org types. Status changes, so the certifier and number are the identity, not the state.

trust.note: Reserved — certification proof points (accredited certifier identity, certificate validity window, revocation signal) as the market defines them. A certification is the strongest trust factor in this corpus and should be first to carry them.
